title: For instances that have at least 2 completed migrations, list the instance
question: For instances that have at least 2 completed migrations, list the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (MB) across system metadata rows (only for display names with at least 3 system metadata entries), the number of completed migrations, and the total memory processed across those completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH completed_migrations AS (
    SELECT 
        m.instance_uuid,
        COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count,
        SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed
    FROM migrations m
    WHERE m.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY m.instance_uuid
    HAVING COUNT(m.id) >= 2
),
metadata_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ism.instance_uuid,
        COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count
    FROM instance_system_metadata ism
    GROUP BY ism.instance_uuid
    HAVING COUNT(ism.id) >= 3
),
memory_stddev_by_display_name AS (
    SELECT 
        i.display_name,
        STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_stddev
    FROM instances i
    JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
    GROUP BY i.display_name
    HAVING COUNT(ism.id) >= 3
)
SELECT 
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.display_name,
    i.availability_zone,
    msd.memory_stddev,
    cm.completed_migration_count,
    cm.total_memory_processed
FROM instances i
JOIN completed_migrations cm ON i.uuid = cm.instance_uuid
JOIN metadata_counts mc ON i.uuid = mc.instance_uuid
JOIN memory_stddev_by_display_name msd ON i.display_name = msd.display_name

SELECT i.uuid,
       i.display_name,
       i.availability_zone,
       STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS mem_stddev,
       COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations,
       SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed
FROM instances i
JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND m.status = 'completed'
JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON sm.instance_uuid = i.uuid
GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.memory_mb
HAVING COUNT(m.id) >= 2
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT sm.id) >= 3;
